summary_1line: Rama begins the tale of King Nimi, who founded Vaijayanta and initiated a long sacrifice after inviting sages including Vasistha and Gautama.

image_candidates.scene_text: King Nimi stands before assembled sages Atri, Angira, Bhrigu, and Vasistha while announcing a grand sacrifice near his splendid city Vaijayanta.
The city of Vaijayanta rises near Gautama’s hermitage, gleaming like a divine capital at the foot of the Himavat mountains.
Sage Vasishtha returns from Indra’s sacrifice and finds Gautama already officiating at Nimi’s massive ritual lasting thousands of years.
